titolo: Heimstaden adopts OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex for property management
descr: Swedish real‑estate firm Heimstaden uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to cut costs and boost staff productivity across Europe.
paragrafi: Heimstaden announced the deployment of OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex in its residential real‑estate operations.
The AI tools are being used to automate routine tasks, streamline communication with tenants, and support internal workflows.
OpenAI’s enterprise‑grade models provide the security and scalability required for large‑scale property management.
Heimstaden’s initiative reflects a growing trend of real‑estate firms adopting generative AI to modernize legacy processes.
perche: For AI users, the case shows how enterprise‑focused models can deliver tangible cost savings in a traditional industry. It also highlights why free or locally hosted models may be less suitable for large organizations that need robust security, compliance and support.
